reviews.text:
We are delighted with Susana and Marcos. They are incredibly kind and friendly, and you can really see the love they have for the animals. They always treat us wonderfully and with so much patience, which is very reassuring.
It's so nice to find a place like this, where, in addition to being excellent professionals, they make you feel right at home. Thank you so much for everything! 🐶❤️
Highly recommended. A welcoming place with excellent service. If you go, ask for Marcos.

Marcos is fantastic. I went for the first time and he's going to be my dog's vet forever. He's incredibly caring and very professional. He answers all your questions and gives you the best advice. Mimo is very happy with him. Thank you, Marcos!
Mango and Dragona are fantastic! Every time they go, their pets are well taken care of and even receive treats while they're being examined, whether it's a puppy or a prize. Highly recommended!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Carmen!!

We started taking our cat Michi to the vet almost a month ago because of an ear infection. From the very first moment, we felt safe and confident thanks to Marcos's care; we've never found such a friendly and welcoming place. 100% recommended. Thank you so much for everything!
Wonderful service, both to the animals and their owners. We've trusted them since my rabbit was a few months old, and now she's 9 years old and we'll still be here.
I do not recommend this veterinary center. They wanted to charge me €10 for a prescription, and on top of that, when I asked for my pet's medical history, they refused to send it to me.
Fantastic service. They cared for our first cat, Rita, for almost 19 years of her life. And now we're following the same path with Suki!

After my trusted veterinarian retired, I was terrified we wouldn't find a place where we'd feel safe and at home, but thanks to a friend's recommendation, we certainly did. There's nothing like finding a place where love for animals, kindness towards humans, empathy, and, of course, professionalism are paramount. At Argos, I know my little ones are in very, very good hands, and that's priceless peace of mind.
Very professional. The service is second to none.
Thank you for your 5-star rating, Chema! We will continue working to always meet your expectations 🤗 …
Susana and Marcos are highly trained and experienced professionals, giving you the confidence to leave your pet's health in good hands; you can see they put a lot of effort into their work.
Great professionals, a guarantee of quality.
Highly skilled professionals with years of experience

I took my dogs there, and I had a bunch of preventative tests done because I think they're necessary, so the care was good in that case. But Truma, the Chihuahua, got sick with acute gastroenteritis. When it's an emergency, they're not equipped to handle it. They made me go to the clinic twice and told me she didn't look that bad, but the second day was a Saturday, so they said they couldn't give her fluids that morning because they were going away for the long weekend. So I took her to a hospital. When I got there, the dog was dying, according to the lab results. At Argos, they didn't do any blood work. I don't understand why, since they had done all sorts of tests before, even for her thyroid when she didn't need it, but now, knowing she had bloody diarrhea, vomiting, and wasn't eating, they didn't do any blood work.
That's what happened. The dog died a week later in the ICU at Veterios, which is another hospital they recommended. Neither Argos nor the hospital can be trusted.

Wonderful. I went there with a sick kitten, and thanks to them, not only has my cat gotten much better, but I'm feeling better too. I really appreciated their kindness towards humans. Not everyone understands the anxiety we owners experience, but they do. And that's something to be grateful for, even though my cat's well-being is the most important thing. I appreciate your patience with me.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating, Enrique!
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating, Gloria!

I wanted to thank Susana and Marcos for all their dedication to our dog, their after-hours visits and tests, and also thank Diego (the ultrasound technician) for his concern. We've had a very anxious and worried week, but thankfully everything turned out well. Susana and Marcos, you are excellent professionals and even better people. I'm so happy to be part of the Argos family. Thank you so much for everything.
At Argos, the service is excellent. They are super professional and always answer any questions and advise you on everything you need. I recommend them 100%. 🌟❤️🌟❤️🌟 …
Punctual and meticulous in the inspection, I loved it

My experience at Argos Veterinary Clinic has been excellent. A few days ago, I took my cat Roque in because he was quite ill. Susana and Marcos are two wonderful and very friendly professionals. They treated him incredibly well, and thanks to all the tests they performed, their follow-up care, and their advice, Roque is now perfectly fine. It's clear they love their work, and that's why I recommend them wholeheartedly. For me, they are top-notch veterinarians, and it's a blessing and a relief to know them.

This is a great clinic. So far, our dog is very well cared for, and above all, they're monitoring her health regularly, which gives us peace of mind regarding the checkups our pet needs. They also have a series of events that foster a sense of community among all the furry friends, with rewards that make visits more enjoyable.
We're delighted with the Argos family. If you have a furry friend, we highly recommend them!
Thank you so much for your five stars, Natalia! They encourage us to keep giving our best every day!
Very kind, always willing to help in any way possible and very patient considering how detached my dog ​​is.

Excellent service, very friendly and approachable. They care deeply about their patients and it's clear they love their work. 100% recommended. Plus, the clinic's plan is very comprehensive and allows you to keep your furry friend's health well-managed ❤️
Super good vets, super friendly with my son Draco my kitten, he's my go-to vet.
Thank you for your 5-star rating, Susana!

Vet Susana's care was wonderful! She's truly a sweetheart! My guinea pig's eye is improving so well! From the very first moment, she inspired confidence and explained everything with great care. She even sent me messages about how my guinea pig is progressing with her treatment! We're so happy to have a vet we can trust!
Fabulous service.

Marcos was excellent, both to me, since I know very little about this, explaining everything, and to my furry bear, who will be better soon!

Thank you so much

We've been going to Argos Veterinary Club with our little Dachshund for almost a year now, and it was definitely the best decision. They've taken care of her from day one, and we have wonderful veterinary insurance that ensures she's always well cared for and protected, with checkups, deworming, vaccinations, and everything up to date. They're always attentive to her appointments and make sure she receives the best care. You can really see the affection, love, dedication, and professionalism they have for animals. I'm delighted with them. Without a doubt, the best place to take your furry friend! ♥️
Great service, delighted to bring my pet there. It was recommended to me a while ago and it was a great choice.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating, Silvia 💕 …
Susana and Marcos are very kind and attentive. I already know them from when they had two kittens, and I'm very happy with their care and suggestions.
My cat has diabetes and in general, the service is good; Marcos explains everything and gives recommendations.

I went to the vet clinic today looking for a harness for my Dachshund and they couldn't have treated me better!!! I was a little undecided, but they helped me quickly and I was able to get the best one!! I'll definitely be back!! 😊😊😊 …
Wonderful, very professional, and affordable service.
Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Amanda!!
Susana and Marcos are top-notch veterinarians. They treat you like family and our furry friends with so much love.
Excellent professionals, they explain everything very simply and treat pets with great care. Highly recommended.
Fantastic! Very professional, it's wonderful how they treat the animals.
Brilliant
Thank you so much for your feedback, Jessica!! ❤️
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating!
Thank you so much, Lucy! We are very grateful for your very positive review!
A trusted veterinarian with very comprehensive health plans for dogs, our Cholo is always delighted when it's time for a check-up, and that says it all!
Attentive and friendly people. Excellent service.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Roberto!
For Toby, Argos is his second home. The treatment, dedication, and affection from Susana and Marcos are the best. Thank you guys for always being there 😘🐶 …
They take care of every detail in their relationship with your pet! Both Marcos and Susana always give my cat excellent service.
Very professional, but above all "like family".

You are a wonderful team! Always attentive, smiling, and helpful, taking great care of the pets with dedication, gentleness, and affection, and offering very interesting advice. Thank you for being there and for everything.

THANK YOU SO MUCH 🤗😚😘
Thank you for your 5-star review, Dani, and for entrusting us with Ume's health!

Everything was perfect! They treat the little ones like their own family ✨🥰🥰🥰
Marcos and Susana, wonderful ❤️ …
I've been taking my dog ​​to this vet for over 10 years and I couldn't be happier with the care and professionalism of Susana and Marcos. I highly recommend this clinic.
Excellent service
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating, Tarsicio!

Marcos and Susana are amazing, very professional and meticulous in their work. Beyond being a vet, they've created a wonderful bond with Bela. The first day she crawled under one of the chairs and wouldn't budge! Now she can't wait for them to open the door so she can come in and get a treat, obviously! The option to join their club is fantastic in every way. We're so happy, highly recommended!!

Bela is our first pet and we had many doubts about everything, but we found this club and Susana and Marcos gave us all the information and reassurance we needed. You can feel their genuine interest in the well-being of the pets, and this is something to value. Communication is easy and fast, the prices are very competitive, and the facilities are always spotless. I recommend it 100% in every respect.
My dog ​​receives excellent treatment every time he goes, and they treat their owners exceptionally well too. I 100% recommend this vet 🫶🏻 …

Thank you so much for your feedback, Daila. At Argos, we work to ensure that both you and your animals (whom we consider our own from the moment they walk through our door :) ) feel healthy and happy!

I'm so glad to have this center in the neighborhood. The service is always warm, friendly, and personalized. Susana and Marcos are always ready to address any concerns we have and take care of our kittens with great dedication and patience. …
Caring towards furry friends and top professionals
Thank you so much for your feedback, Carlos! We're delighted to have you with us!

Excellent veterinarian. The treatment and care of the animals is impeccable. I've had my two animals with them since the beginning, and they are very well cared for and up-to-date on everything. 100% recommended.
They are super professional...and treat my pets wonderfully.

Professional, attentive, caring... You couldn't ask for more. I have complete confidence in you. Thank you for demonstrating your dedication every day and inspiring some of us to join this profession. Greetings from Perli and Lorena
